items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: But I haven't heard him play in a little while. That's because I know him and I see him quite often.

ctx.x: He's improved quite a bit since then. Yeah.

I haven't heard him play lately. That's with Frogman Henry now. Yeah. I've heard him about maybe seven, eight months, something like that. I haven't heard him play lately. That's because I know him and I see him quite often. But I haven't heard him play in a little while.
But you did get some royalty checks from your Checo records? Yeah.
